label: Issues
description: Open problems that stop purchases from reaching TikTok. A new record sends the store's administrators an email.

key.label: Key
key.description: Identifies the problem: credentials, throttled or invalid. A repeat updates the same record.

source.label: Met while handling
source.description: The store event or app action that met the problem.

app_id.label: App
app_id.description: The app's record id in this store. The email links to the app's page with it.
